newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia sells record 133,765 T coffee in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia sells record 133,765 T coffee in 1996/97.

text.p: Ethiopian exported a record 133,765 tonnes of coffee worth $409.4 million in 1996/97 (July/June), compared to 102,000 tonnes worth $279.5 million in 1995/96.

Aster Estifanos, head of planning in the Ethiopian Coffee and Tea Development Authority, told Reuters in an interview that 119,000 tonnes of the total, worth $354.5 million, has already been exported and the balance would be shipped in coming months.
The 1996/97 exports were well over the 108,000 tonnes forecast by coffee authorities earlier in the year.
Aster attributed this year's booming coffee trade to the government's liberal economic policy.
Ethiopia's coffee year runs from October to September but computation of sales is normally based on the fiscal year (July/June).

Aster did not give a forecast for exports in 1997/98 but has said Ethiopia wanted to improve production to the 300,000-tonne mark from 200,000 to 250,000 tonnes now. Ethiopians consume a high percentage of their coffee.
